{{short description|American mathematician}}
'''Joseph D. E. Konhauser''' (1924 – February 1992) was an American [[mathematician]] who introduced [[Konhauser polynomials]]. He was a professor at [[Macalester College]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Competitions and Problem Solving |url=https://www.macalester.edu/mscs/studentopportunities/competitions/ |access-date=2022-11-13 |website=Macalester College |language=en-US}}</ref> He also organized many [[mathematical problem]]s competitions. The annual Konhauser Problemfest is named after him.
